name: Exec Cluster Cost: Crypto — MakerTaker Commission + 10bps Slippage
description: Tests: MakerTaker commission (2/5 bps) + 10bps slippage. Run with --cost crypto
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: Crypto-Style MakerTaker Commission
# Run with: --cost crypto --cash 100000
# Validates: MakerTaker commission model (2bps maker, 5bps taker), BPS slippage
# Uses equity assets as proxy (validates cost model, not asset class)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: RSI mean reversion (high frequency for many trades) ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 7)
entry = rsi_val < 25
exit = rsi_val > 75
held = hold_until(entry, exit)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=3)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
